summary: Comprehensive testing of 3 bug fixes: 1) Cancel friendly match button (window.confirm on web), 2) Cancelled matches show in calendar with red badge and strikethrough, 3) Amend button opens calendar picker modal. All backend tests passed (7/9, 2 skipped due to test data state). All frontend features verified with screenshots.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 friendly invites for testing: 1) Invite for CANCEL test (cancelled via frontend), 2) Invite for AMEND test (still accepted for future testing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: 1) CANCEL button on web uses window.confirm instead of Alert.alert - confirmed working, 2) Calendar API includes cancelled status, frontend shows red 'Cancelled' badge and strikethrough opponent name, 3) AMEND button opens 'Propose New Dates' modal with calendar picker. Test data: Storm G14 team has 2 cancelled invites and 1 accepted invite in friendly matches.

Bug Fix 1 - Cancel button on web (window.details: The cancelInvite function in friendly-matches.tsx correctly uses Platform.OS check: window.confirm on web, Alert.alert on native. Clicking CANCEL button triggers confirm dialog and successfully cancels the match. Match moves to CANCELLED/DECLINED section.

Bug Fix 2 - Cancelled matches in calenda.details: Calendar endpoint GET /api/teams/{team_id}/calendar now includes status='cancelled' in query filter. Frontend calendar.tsx shows cancelled events with: 1) Red 'Cancelled' badge, 2) Strikethrough text on opponent name (cancelledText style), 3) Dimmed appearance (eventCancelled style with opacity 0.55).

Bug Fix 3 - Amend button opens calendar.details: AMEND button (data-testid='amend-{id}') opens 'Propose New Dates' modal showing: 1) Current accepted date, 2) Calendar picker for selecting new dates, 3) 'PROPOSE NEW DATES' submit button. Backend amend endpoint sets status to 'pending' and clears accepted_date.

Backend: PUT /api/friendly-invites/{id}/.details: Endpoint changes status from 'accepted' or 'pending' to 'cancelled'. Returns 200 with {message: 'Match cancelled'}. Creates notification message for the other party.
Endpoint sets status='pending', clears accepted_date and accepted_time, updates proposed_dates. Returns 404 for non-accepted invites. Creates notification message for the other party.

Backend: Calendar includes cancelled inv.details: GET /api/teams/{team_id}/calendar query filter includes {"$in": ["accepted", "cancelled"]} for friendly_invites status. Cancelled events returned with status='cancelled' field.
